name: Unbalanced Octree Construction
aliases: Bottom-up recursive construction of an unbalanced octree
definition: Bottom-up recursive construction of an unbalanced octree for the Solid mesh, grouping bounding spheres into up to eight clusters.
summary: Unbalanced Octree Construction builds adaptive-resolution octrees from sorted leaf nodes to reduce memory and traversal time by increasing the branching factor compared to quadtrees.
